description: Fix progress bar visibility in service-allowance-indicator.tsx and make override badge in service-log-list-item.tsx more subtle
steps: In apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-allowance-indicator.tsx, change the progress bar track from `bg-custom-background-80 h-2` to use a more distinct/darker track color (like `bg-custom-background-90` or a more visible custom class) and increase height to `h-2.5` or `h-3` for better visibility against `bg-surface-2`.

In apps/web/core/components/service-logs/service-log-list-item.tsx, make the override badge (is_hour_type_overridden section) more subtle. Currently it shows `{segment.suggested_hour_type_name}` as a visible badge. Replace it with a tooltip-only approach: show a small subtle inline text (like strikethrough or a dim italic note) instead of a solid background badge. The key goal is that users should NOT mistake the override suggestion for the applied type.

Also ensure the `classification_reason` text remains subtle (text-custom-text-400, no yellow styling). It currently uses `text-xs text-custom-text-400` which should be fine but verify no other class might override it to a warm/yellow color.
acceptance_criteria: The progress bar in service-allowance-indicator.tsx has a visually distinct track background that contrasts clearly with bg-surface-2
The progress bar height is increased (h-2.5 or h-3) making it more noticeable
The override badge in service-log-list-item.tsx no longer uses a prominent background color; it is rendered as a subtle tooltip-only indicator or very subdued text
The classification_reason text remains in text-custom-text-400 without any highlighting
Lint passes on the modified files
